component.name: Big OCR PDF
component.summary: Make scanned PDFs searchable with OCR

description.p: Big OCR PDF recognizes text in scanned PDF documents and creates searchable, copyable PDF files while preserving the original pages.
It also recognizes text in images and screen captures, and includes tools to reorder, rotate, merge, split, and compress PDF pages.
Pages are read by ppocr-native, which runs PP-OCRv6 on the CPU in a fraction of the memory the previous engine needed.

ul.li: Greek, Cyrillic and extended Latin text stays searchable and copyable
The PDF editor saves in the background and reports failed saves
Double-spaced pages and headings survive text, Markdown and ODT export
The interface follows the chosen icon theme and is complete in every translation
